name: Faribault
celebrates: Faribault packs its Christmas into Winterfest, a three night celebration the Faribault Area Chamber of Commerce and Tourism calls its 10th annual, running December 3 to 5, 2026. Thursday brings Hometown Holidays at the Buckham Center with Santa, Mrs. Claus, a bounce house, carriage rides and ice carving. Friday has the new Viaduct Park ice rink opening, the Grinch and the Faribault Parks and Recreation tree lighting. Saturday has free Santa photos with a Christmas story time, the Parade of Lights downtown at 5:30 pm and fireworks.
lastyear: Visit Faribault's page for the 2025 festival billed it as the 9th Annual Faribault Winterfest, held December 4 to 6, with the tagline Embrace the Magic. We did not find a published recap with attendance numbers for 2025. The chamber's 2026 schedule adds the new Viaduct Park ice rink opening on Friday, December 4, and a Window Decorating Contest whose ballots go to the Buckham Library.
facts: Winterfest begins Thursday with an open house at South Central College from 3 to 6 pm with appetizers, drinks and Dueling Pianos. The ice carving by Sakatah Ice Carver runs from 5 to 7 pm at the Buckham Center, and the Winter Street Dance after the parade runs from 6 to 10 pm with a beer garden, heated tent and bonfires. The Ugly Sweater Walk and Run on Saturday starts at 9 am at Viaduct Park.
trains: Faribault's Winterfest schedule has no train ride that we could verify. The CPKC Holiday Train's 2026 stop list on Explore Minnesota and Minnesota Parent includes Rochester and Cottage Grove, and the Cottage Grove stop is on December 13 at 5:15 pm. In Saint Paul, the Minnesota Transportation Museum runs a Saturday train ride from the 1907 Jackson Street Roundhouse, and the Twin City Model Railroad Museum runs Night Trains for a longer day trip.

Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 5:30 pm in historic downtown Faribault, followed by fireworks near Viaduct Park.
Where can kids meet Santa in Faribault?
At Hometown Holidays at the Buckham Center on December 3 and at free Photos With Santa at Tony Langerud State Farm on December 5.
